_about: Every rule the prototype applies. Each entry is {value, label, why}. 'your-input' = Meena's judgment (CHANGE-BRIEF §5); 'record' = copied from a repo file. Python reads these; it hardcodes no threshold or p value.

data_family_phrases.label: your-input
data_family_phrases.why: CHANGE-BRIEF §5b: phrase allowlist tied to the target titles. Case-insensitive substring match (Q5). Precision over recall: a false positive costs tailoring hours.

seniority.label: your-input
seniority.why: CHANGE-BRIEF §5c + Q5: words and level tokens match as whole tokens anywhere in the title; any standalone number >= 3 is senior. First bucket in bucket_precedence that fires wins. 'Unmarked' is not proof of entry level.

min_approvals_for_proven.label: your-input
min_approvals_for_proven.why: CHANGE-BRIEF §5d: prompted by 68 companies showing 100% approval on <= 3 approvals.

tier_precedence.label: your-input
tier_precedence.why: Q8: first match wins. p values are ordinal encodings, not calibrated probabilities (§5d). Proven is 0.7 so sponsorship alone (0.35 x 0.7 = 0.245) cannot reach Apply. null p = the scorer drops the vote; it is never zero-filled.

by_evidence_group.entry-under-min-approvals: Thin evidence (fewer than the minimum approvals). Confirm sponsorship with a recruiter or employee before tailoring.
by_evidence_group.only-mid: They sponsor data roles at mid level. Network: ask whether they hire and sponsor new grads into this team.
by_evidence_group.only-senior: They sponsor only senior data roles. Network, don't apply cold: ask about entry-level sponsorship before tailoring.
by_evidence_group.no-data-title: They sponsor, but not data roles. Low priority: network only through a warm contact.
by_evidence_group.no-record: No record is not evidence of non-sponsorship. Verify sponsorship through networking before tailoring.

next_action.label: your-input
next_action.why: Precedence: if the scorer's recommendation is Skip because a gate closed, gate_closed applies ({gate} = the closed gate, read from the scorer's own trace and gate_zero). Otherwise by_evidence_group. Next action is advice only and never changes the scorer's recommendation.

timeline_factors.label: your-input
timeline_factors.why: Revision 1 (§7 corrected): projected_start = as_of + hiring_lag_days; window_end = opt_start + window_days (inclusive). projected_start <= window_end -> 1.0; a projected start before opt_start is a deferred start (non-scoring note), not a failure. projected_start > window_end -> 0.0.

sample.label: your-input
sample.why: build_sample.py draws per_group companies from each evidence group, in this order, with one random.Random(seed). Frozen once written.

value.suffix_source: scripts/sec/sec-all-quarters.py (COMPANY_SUFFIXES, read with ast; not executed)

provenance.label: record
provenance.why: Paths and the hash are facts about repo files; a hash mismatch stops the whole run.
